meta.what: The climate's weather (src/xrEngine/da_climate.cpp, docs/dead-air/WEATHER.md): shares of the hours of each month by sky, the precipitation, the wind, the melt; and the scalars of the processes, the snowpack and the ice
meta.sources: _work research of 15.10.2026 (climate_research.md): Kyiv 33345 / Gomel 33041 SYNOP tables (pogodaiklimat), WMO 1991-2020 normals (Kyiv, Ovruch, Gomel, Bragin), NOAA Chornobyl 1981-2010, Gomel precipitation durations (Leonovich 2012), Ukrhydromet hazard criteria, DSNS ice rules

derivations.p_clear: share of hours under 0-2/10 total cloud: Kyiv/Gomel clear days + clear hours of partly cloudy days (mean total cloud 7.7-8.2 tenths in Dec-Jan, 4.6-5.5 in Jul-Aug)
derivations.p_overcast: share of hours under 8-10/10 total cloud, the wet hours included: overcast days (Kyiv 5-20, Gomel 6-23 a month) and the overcast hours of other days
derivations.p_wet: share of hours with precipitation falling: Gomel solid 430 h + mixed 91 h + liquid 611 h a year, split by snowfall, mixed and rain days of each month (5.7 / 4.7 / 4.4 h a day)
derivations.p_fog: fog hours: fog days (mean of Kyiv and Gomel) x 6.5 h
derivations.wind_ms: Kyiv mean wind at 10 m, WMO 1991-2020
derivations.p_blizzard: share of snow hours with a blizzard: blizzard days (Kyiv/Gomel 6-7 a year, 1-2 a month Nov-Mar) x ~5 h over the month's snow hours
derivations.p_storm: share of rain hours of a rainstorm (heavy rain and a gale): days of wind >= 15 m/s with rain
derivations.p_thunder: share of rain hours with thunder: thunder days x 2 h over the month's rain hours
derivations.cloud_t_corr: a clear winter sky is a cold anticyclone (positive), a clear summer sky a hot one (negative)
derivations.fog_dawn: radiation fog before dawn (summer: 1) against all-day advective fog (winter: 0.3)
derivations.ddf: degree-day melt factor on the day's mean (mm w.e. per C per day): open field 5 (BSUIR), calibrated down in Dec-Feb (low sun, cold content) so that a 30-year run gives Kyiv's mean depths (Dec 5, Jan 9, Feb 11 cm)

meta.calibration: scratchpad climate_sim.py, 20 years: snow Jan 7.6 / Feb 10.2 cm mean, cover 91 %; pond ice 1 Jan 16 cm, 1 Feb 23 cm, 15 Feb 23 cm; walkable (>= 7 cm) Dec 79 %, Jan 97 %, Feb 99 %, Mar 50 %, Nov 10 %; blizzard 10 h/month Jan-Feb
